explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1125 with Laczkovich's positive answer: every f : ℝ → ℝ satisfying 2f(x) ≤ f(x+h) + f(x+2h) for all x and h > 0 is monotone. Using Monotone (non-decreasing) rather than 'monotone in either direction' is correct. A strictly decreasing f violates the inequality, as f = -x shows: -2x ≤ -2x - 3h fails. So the only possible monotonicity is non-decreasing.
